eps.d: Eliot Shag is having a tough time thinking up a new idea for an Ace Hart Adventure - until a squeaky toy named Mr. Mokey sparks his imagination. Unfortunately, the plot lands Ace nose-to-nose with the infamous gang of Bugsy the Dogfather and his mongrel mafia!
A loose screw in Eliot's animation desk causes him great aggravation, but it also becomes the inspiration for another adventure with Ace Hart.
Eliot is ordered by his boss to draw a story with violence in it. Unfortunately, this goes against Elliot's belief that violence is unnecessary.
Eliot is trying to help his friend Artie cope with starting a new school year at a brand new school.
Eliot is accused of having chewed Bruno's favorite slipper, and he's placed under dog house arrest in his very own home.
Eliot Shag's inspiration for his next Ace Hart Adventure comes from his television repair man who's nostalgic for the good ole days of radio.
Eliot's suspicions and fears about Colleen's new friend result in a madcap adventure that has Dog City howling in fear.
Coleen Barker, Eliot's neighbor, asks Eliot to puppysit her nephew Pomeroy.
Eliot Shag's boss at the network wants a more up-to-date, funky Ace Hart show. Buno delights in the news, hoping that Eliot will be evicted from his apartment.
Eliot falls asleep at his animation table after a long hard day dreaming a new Ace Hart Adventure.
Bruno is convinced that aliens are invading Dog City. Eliot decides to take this as a cue for his next Ace Hart Adventure.
Cats are moving into Eliot's apartment building, and Bruno will not allow it. This gives Eliot inspiration for his latest Ace Hart Adventure.
Artie has decided he has a new detective hero--someone who uses a cool detecting kit to solve his mysteries.

Arch bad dog Bugsy Ville is sentenced to the Dog Pound after naming his dumb dumb nephew Bruiser as the gang's new Dogfather. But even with Ace and Roise hot on his tail, Bruiser somehow pulls off a series of brilliant crimes that prove every dog does have his day!
After meeting Artie's mother, Eliot catches Spring Fever. He creates an array of embarrassing romantic moments for Ace and Rosie while they attempt to rescue the mayor's secretary from the Vile gang.

Dog City's annual shipment of flea powder has been pilfered and Hijacked And Ace Hart the local flatpaw along with the lovely Chief of detectives Rosie O'Gravy are itching to sniff out the culprits! Ace finds himself barking up the wrong tree, untill though a poetry spouting bow wow named Mad Dog that lends Ace and the flatpaws a paw!
Rosie and Ace become blues-singing hoboes when the newly-elected Mayor Vile strips them of their dog licenses.
Eliot swaps superhero stories with Artie and decides it's time to introduce a superhero to Dog City. However, when the "Watch Dog" quickly rises to star status, Ace gets jealous.
When Ace learns Eliot plans to invite Artie's mom on a date, Ace announces: romance is for saps. Eliot disagrees and sets up a classic film noir to prove his point.

eps.t: Out of the Mouths of Pups
eps.d: Artie's enthusiasm plus some fun letters, inspire Eliot to do a story with all the favorite characters, featuring Eddie as kidnap victim. The Vile Gang get more chatter and advice from Eddie than they can stand.
When Rosie is missing, Ace is hired to find her. With clever sleuthing and a series of interviews, he discovers things about Rosie he never imagined.

Eliot Shag is overjoyed when his former art teacher Scratch McCollie drops by for a vist, Until the old pooch starts giving out unwanted advice. But when Scratch's aging cartoon detective Sam Spayed teams up with Ace Hart it turns into a dog gone great adventure!
Eliot is ill but must meet a story deadline. Much to Ace's annoyance, Eliot's creative neighbors all pitch in to help, injecting their own styles to story and animation as they take turns.

Ace Hart adventures in Jurassic Bark complete with the Bugsy Vile gang, while Eliot helps Artie grapple with the trials and tribulations of creativity. We also meet new characters for this season such as Yves'n Steven-Yves, a cat burglar whose attempts at stealing the guarded prized possession are always foiled by Steven, the happy go lucky guard dog.

Eliot shows Artie that learning can be fun after Terri voices her concern over Artie's poor math grade. Meanwhile, Ace Hart tries to solve a case involving Bernie, the big pink star of the wildly popular kiddy show and discovers it's the Vile gang. We also meet Bugsy vile in "His Master's Choice Theater" as he reads to us a twisted version of Aesop's fable.

Eliot salutes the horror genre in this chiller thriller, but strange things start happening in his own building as Artie, Bruno and Eliot begin to think that Bruiser has gone mad in a case of mistaken identity. Meanwhile Ace Hart and Eddie have stumbled onto a plot by Rottweiler to take over the world with his Sci - Fido monster and Rosie as it's bride! Mr.

Eliot helps Artie to understand that a hero doesn't have to be a superhero. Sometimes heroes are just ordinary dogs doing ordinary things, like his mom, Terri. Ace and Bugsy battle it out for the "Hero of the Year " award. Mr. Moogie saves the day by shrinking himself small enough to go into the stomach of the Presidog to fight a patch of bad grass.

Artie has every doggie in the building recycling, but not before he makes life miserable, especially for Eliot!Meanwhile, Ace Hart uncovers another plot by the Baron Bon Rottweiler to take over the world when all the trees in Dog City are tree napped.

Eliot and Artie help each other overcome their fear of the future. While Ace and Eddie chase Rottweilers most recently commissioned world domination device -- a doggie door time portal machine. Yves la Chance's ancestor carries on the family name as the greatest cat burglar in the cosmos - but Stevens great great grandson hasn't changed a bit.

Eliot kicks off a crash exercise course with Artie as his trainer so he can run with Terri in the Dog City marathon and learns that you can't get in shape overnight. Ace Hart gets his fair share of exercise at the Fido Olympics, as he tries to solve the mysterious disappearance of the athletes and ends up competing against Bugsy Vile! Mr.

eps.t: The Dog Days of Summer Vacation
eps.d: It's the summer and everyone is excited, about to disperse on their vacations. Eliot however is stuck behind doing a show so he sends Ace and Rosie on a vacation, accompanied by Eddie and Dot.
